meta.description: Unified tuning presets library for guitar and bass. Filter by instrument and string_count for UI display. Each preset has a section tag for category grouping, aliases for band-specific names, and notes for contextual info.

sections.STD: Standard — uniform interval tunings. Transposing between these requires no re-learning of shapes.
sections.DRP: Drop — lowest string dropped one whole step below the standard interval. Enables one-finger power chords on bottom strings.
sections.OPN: Open — open strings form a chord. Common in slide and fingerstyle contexts. Guitar only.
sections.MOD: Modal / Irregular — non-standard interval patterns. Shapes do not transfer from standard.
sections.D7G: DADGAD 7str family — 7-string expansion of DADGAD modal logic. Shared lineage across djent/prog scene (FellSilent → TesseracT / Monuments / ERRA). Guitar only.
sections.EXT: Extended range reconfiguration — instrument reconfigured to cover a different range without adding strings (e.g. BEAD on 4-string bass). Bass only.
sections.UNQ: Unique — band-specific tunings that cannot be reduced to any standard/drop/modal category. Interval structure is non-transferable.

fields.section: Category tag (STD / DRP / OPN / MOD / D7G / EXT / UNQ)
fields.label: Display name
fields.strings: Array of note+octave from lowest (index 0) to highest
fields.aliases: Band/song-specific names for this tuning (may be empty)

presets.label: E Standard
presets.notes: Universal baseline. Most guitar pedagogy and tablature assumes this tuning.

presets.label: Eb Standard
presets.notes: Half step down. SRV, Van Halen, Guns N' Roses. Slightly looser feel.

presets.label: D Standard
presets.notes: Full step down. Common in heavy rock and metal. Shapes identical to E Standard.

presets.label: C Standard
presets.notes: Two steps down. Very dark, requires heavier strings. Popular in doom/sludge.

presets.label: B Standard
presets.notes: Two and a half steps down. Approaches 7-string range on a 6-string.

presets.label: A Standard
presets.notes: Three and a half steps down. Extreme low end; typically requires baritone scale.

presets.label: B Standard (7str)
presets.notes: Factory standard for most 7-string guitars. Upper 6 strings identical to E Standard.

presets.label: Bb Standard (7str)
presets.notes: Half step below B Standard 7str. Meshuggah's primary tuning before switching to 8-string.

presets.label: A Standard (7str)
presets.notes: Full step below B Standard 7str. Common in progressive metal.

presets.label: Ab Standard (7str)
presets.notes: One and a half steps below B Standard 7str.

presets.label: F# Standard (8str)
presets.notes: Factory standard for most 8-string guitars. Upper 7 strings = B Standard 7str. Periphery, Animals as Leaders.

presets.label: F Standard (8str)
presets.notes: Half step below F# Standard 8str. Meshuggah's primary 8-string tuning. Upper 7 strings = Bb Standard 7str.

presets.label: C# Standard (9str)
presets.notes: Standard 9-string tuning. Upper 6 strings = E Standard. Used by Tosin Abasi ('Private Visions of the World'), Stephen Carpenter (Deftones 'Ohms'), After the Burial.

presets.label: G# Standard (10str)
presets.notes: Standard 10-string tuning by fourths extension. Upper 9 strings = C# Standard 9str.

presets.label: Yepes Tuning (10str)
presets.notes: Narciso Yepes' classical 10-string tuning. Upper 6 = E Standard. Lower 4 (Gb/Ab/Bb/C) designed to provide sympathetic resonance for all 12 chromatic pitches. Non-standard re-entrant lower strings.

presets.label: Drop D
presets.notes: Most common alternate tuning. Low E dropped to D, enabling one-finger power chords. Nirvana, Foo Fighters, Tool.

presets.label: Double Drop D
presets.notes: Both E strings dropped to D. Neil Young 'Cinnamon Girl'. Fingerpicking-oriented.

presets.label: Drop C
presets.notes: D Standard with low string dropped to C. System of a Down, Periphery (main 6str tuning), Bullet for My Valentine.

presets.label: Drop B
presets.notes: C Standard with low string dropped to B. Slipknot 'Duality', Tool, Disturbed.

presets.label: Drop A
presets.notes: B Standard with low string dropped to A. Animals as Leaders, Mastodon (Remission era), Periphery.

presets.label: Drop A (7str)
presets.notes: B Standard 7str with low string dropped to A. Standard heavy 7-string tuning.

presets.label: Drop G (7str)
presets.notes: Lowest string dropped to G1. Common in modern heavy and progressive metal. Derived from D Standard with G1 on the bottom.

presets.label: Drop G# (7str)
presets.notes: Ab Standard 7str with low string dropped. ERRA primary live tuning. Trivium, After the Burial, Periphery.

presets.label: Drop F# (7str)
presets.notes: One and a half steps below Drop A 7str. ERRA self-titled album, Monuments 'I, The Destroyer', Deftones, Rivers of Nihil.

presets.label: Drop F (7str)
presets.notes: Two steps below Drop A 7str. Northlane, Vildhjarta, extreme low tuning territory.

presets.label: Drop E (7str)
presets.notes: Two and a half steps below Drop A 7str. Oceano, Currents, ERRA (recent singles), Invent Animate.

presets.label: Drop E (8str)
presets.notes: F# Standard 8str with low string dropped to E. Tosin Abasi / Animals as Leaders primary tuning. Upper 6 strings = E Standard.

presets.label: Drop B (9str)
presets.notes: C# Standard 9str with low string dropped to B. Used in djent/progressive metal context.

presets.label: Drop A (9str)
presets.notes: C# Standard 9str with low string dropped to A. Extreme sub-guitar range. Heavy single-note riff focus.

presets.label: Open D
presets.notes: Open strings form D major chord. Slide guitar, Joni Mitchell 'Big Yellow Taxi', Nick Drake.

presets.label: Open E
presets.notes: Open D raised one whole step. Derek Trucks, Duane Allman. Higher tension — caution on acoustic.

presets.label: Open G
presets.notes: Open strings form G major chord. Keith Richards, Jimmy Page, Robert Johnson.

presets.label: Open C
presets.notes: Open strings form C major chord. Led Zeppelin 'Friends', Soundgarden 'A Thousand Days Before'.

presets.label: Open Cadd9
presets.notes: Open C variant with added 9th. Periphery 'Scarlet'. Warm, extended chord voicings on open strings.

presets.label: Open Cm(add9)
presets.notes: Minor version of Open Cadd9. Periphery / Haunted Shores (Mark Holcomb). 3rd string flattened by half step.

presets.label: DADGAD
presets.notes: Open strings form Dsus4. Celtic folk origin. Led Zeppelin 'Kashmir', TTNG, John Browne (Monuments) used as compositional base.

presets.label: New Standard Tuning
presets.notes: All fifths except top interval. Developed by Robert Fripp (King Crimson). Wider range, unfamiliar shapes.

presets.label: All Fourths
presets.notes: Removes the major-third anomaly between G and B. Symmetrical scale patterns. Experimental / jazz context.

presets.label: Yvette Tuning
presets.notes: Open D with high string raised one whole step. Covet (Yvette Young) 'Nautilus', TTNG 'Panda'. Chord tapping-friendly.

presets.label: Math Rock F
presets.notes: Irregular interval sequence. Used by TTNG and adjacent math rock artists. Non-standard chord geometry.

presets.label: DADGAD 7str — Bb
presets.notes: 7-string expansion of DADGAD modal logic, rooted at Bb. Shared lineage: FellSilent → TesseracT / Monuments / ERRA. Upper 6 strings build a suspended/modal chord cluster rather than standard intervals.

presets.label: DADGAD 7str — Ab
presets.notes: D7G-Bb with low string dropped one whole step. Monuments 'Atlas', TesseracT 'Oblique' / 'Sleeper Awakes'. Only the lowest string differs from D7G-Bb.

presets.label: DADGAD 7str — A
presets.notes: Earlier TesseracT tuning. DADGAD-family structure a minor second above D7G-Bb.

presets.label: Lune Tuning
presets.notes: Periphery 'Lune'. 5-6 string interval is a major 2nd (non-standard). Simulates 7-string drop A range on a 6-string. Misha Mansoor conceived during vacation with only a 6-string available.

presets.label: Flatline Tuning
presets.notes: Periphery 'Flatline' (Periphery III). Retained as unique due to established name. All strings tuned half step below Drop A 7str.

presets.label: Tosin Tuning
presets.notes: Tosin Abasi origin. 6-7 string interval is a minor 3rd — non-standard. Periphery used on 'Racecar'. Dissonant low-end character.

presets.label: Monuments Drop F#
presets.notes: Monuments-specific. Upper 5 strings are in D# standard, incompatible with standard Drop F# (DRP-F#7). 3rd-4th string interval is a major 2nd.

presets.label: ERRA Drift Main
presets.notes: ERRA 'Drift' album (2016). 'Luminesce', 'Irreversible', 'Drift', 'Continuum'. 3-4 string interval is a major 3rd — diverges from standard Drop G# 7str.

presets.label: AAL Woven Web
presets.notes: Animals as Leaders 'The Woven Web'. Strings 8, 6, 4 all tuned to D across three octaves. Non-linear interval structure.

presets.label: Meshuggah Spasm
presets.notes: Meshuggah 'Spasm'. 8th string dropped to Bb0 — one octave below the 7th string. Extreme sub-bass. Unique even within Meshuggah's catalog.

presets.label: E Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Universal baseline for 4-string bass. Matches lowest 4 strings of guitar one octave lower. Used across all genres.

presets.label: Eb Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Half step down. Follows guitarist's Eb tuning. SRV-era, grunge, classic rock context.

presets.label: D Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Full step down. Matches D Standard guitar. Heavy rock, metal context.

presets.label: C Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Two steps down. Doom, sludge, extreme metal. Anthony Jackson used C Standard on sessions with Chaka Khan.

presets.label: B Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Two and a half steps down. Approaches 5-string territory. Requires heavy gauge strings.

presets.label: Bb Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Meshuggah's bass tuning on early albums (pre-Nothing), tracking with 7-string Bb Standard guitars.

presets.label: F Standard (4str)
presets.notes: Meshuggah bass from 'Nothing' onwards. Tuned up a half step from EADG to sit in the same octave as the 8-string guitars. Dick Lövgren primary tuning.

presets.label: B Standard (5str)
presets.notes: Factory standard for most 5-string basses. Adds low B below 4-string standard. Metal, jazz, gospel, funk.

presets.label: Bb Standard (5str)
presets.notes: Meshuggah transition tuning. Dick Lövgren used Bb-F-Bb-Eb-Ab to cover both old and new material simultaneously (see UNQ-MSG5).

presets.label: A Standard (5str)
presets.notes: One step below B Standard 5str. Extreme low tuning for djent/metal context.

presets.label: High C (5str)
presets.notes: Adds high C instead of low B. Steve Swallow, jazz soloists. Original Fender Bass V (1965) used this layout.

presets.label: B Standard (6str)
presets.notes: Standard 6-string bass. Adds low B and high C to 4-string standard. Jazz fusion, progressive rock, solo bass. Anthony Jackson's 'contrabass guitar' concept.

presets.label: Baritone 6str (BEADGB)
presets.notes: 6-string bass with high B instead of high C. Closer to guitar territory on upper strings.

presets.label: F# Standard (7str bass)
presets.notes: Most common 7-string bass tuning. Low F# added below 6-string standard. Michael Tobias / Garry Goodman original. Warwick custom fretless 7str for Jeroen Paul Thesseling uses this layout.

presets.label: B Standard (7str bass)
presets.notes: 6-string standard with high F added. Garry Goodman / Bill Dickens (Conklin GT7). High-register solo and tapping focus.

presets.label: F# Standard (8str bass)
presets.notes: Standard 8-string bass tuning. F# added low to 7str (BEADGCF). Most common 8-string ERB layout.

presets.label: F# Standard (9str bass)
presets.notes: Standard 9-string bass. Bb added high to 8str standard. Bill 'Buddha' Dickens — Bill Conklin built the first 9-string bass for him in 1995.

presets.label: C# Standard (10str bass — low ext.)
presets.notes: 10-string bass with C# added low below 9str. Garry Goodman's Adler 12-string bass and similar extreme ERBs use this foundation.

presets.label: F# Standard (10str bass — high ext.)
presets.notes: 10-string bass with Eb added high above 9str. Alternative to low-extension 10str layout.

presets.label: C# Standard (11str bass)
presets.notes: 11-string bass by adding Eb high to 10str low-ext layout. Extreme ERB territory. Primarily custom luthier builds.

presets.label: C# Standard (12str bass)
presets.notes: 12-string bass. Garry Goodman's Adler 12-string with 36 frets spans 8 octaves — equivalent range to a grand piano. Extreme custom instrument.

presets.label: Drop D (4str)
presets.notes: Most common alternate bass tuning. Low E dropped to D. Matches Drop D guitar. Rock, metal, grunge.

presets.label: Drop C (4str)
presets.notes: D Standard with low string dropped to C. Matches Drop C guitar. Heavy metal, metalcore context.

presets.label: Drop B (4str)
presets.notes: C Standard with low string dropped to B. Extreme low territory on 4-string. Matches Drop B guitar.

presets.label: Drop A (4str)
presets.notes: B Standard with low string dropped to A. Sub-bass range. Matches Drop A guitar. Djent/deathcore context.

presets.label: Drop Bb (4str)
presets.notes: Meshuggah: Dick Lövgren uses this 4-string configuration for specific songs like 'Bleed' (obZen).

presets.label: Drop A (5str)
presets.notes: B Standard 5str with low string dropped to A. Extended low range for heavy 5-string context.

presets.label: Drop G (5str)
presets.notes: A Standard 5str with low string dropped. Extreme sub-bass. Deathcore / extreme metal context.

presets.label: BEAD (4str)
presets.notes: 4-string tuned to lowest 4 strings of a 5-string. Drops the G string in favor of low B. Ross Valory (Journey) used this early on. For players who need low B without moving to 5-string.

presets.label: EADC (4str)
presets.notes: Standard E with high G replaced by high C. Extends upper register. Niche solo/melodic context.

presets.label: Fifths (4str)
presets.notes: All-fifths tuning like cello. Wider range than fourths. Richer overtones. Used by some jazz and classical-crossover bassists.

presets.label: Tenor Bass (4str)
presets.notes: Standard tuning raised one perfect fourth. Guitar-like register. Stanley Clarke, Victor Wooten, Stu Hamm for solo melodic playing.

presets.label: Piccolo Bass (4str)
presets.notes: Standard tuning up one octave using thin strings. Same pitches as bottom 4 strings of guitar. Carl Thompson built first piccolo bass for Stanley Clarke. Les Claypool uses one with 29 frets.

presets.label: Meshuggah 5str (transition)
presets.notes: Dick Lövgren's touring 5-string tuning. Allows simultaneous coverage of old Bb Standard (strings 2-5) and Nothing-era F Standard (low Bb) material. Non-standard 1-2 string interval (P5 instead of P4).
